name: get_activity
title: Activity details
description: Retrieves the activity summary, metadata, measurements, and split summary information for the specified activity.

activityId.description: The ID of the activity to retrieve the summary

name: get_activity_workouts
title: Activity workouts
description: Retrieves workouts performed during an activity

activityId.description: The ID of the activity for which to retrieve workouts

name: search_activities
title: Search activities
description: Searches activities using the supplied filters and returns matching paginated activity summaries. Results are sorted by start time, newest first, unless sortBy/sortOrder are given. Page through results with start and limit.

start.description: Zero-based offset of the first activity to return. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: Maximum number of activities to return (Garmin allows up to 99). Defaults to 20 to keep responses small.

favorite.description: Filter by favorite status: 1 returns favorites, 0 returns non-favorites, and -1 applies no favorite filter. Defaults to -1.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction: asc for ascending or desc for descending, case-insensitive. Defaults to desc.

excludeChildren.description: Whether to exclude child activities that have a parent activity, such as individual legs of a multisport activity. Defaults to true.

sortBy.description: Activity field to sort by, such as name, distance, or duration. Defaults to startLocal, the activity's local start date and time.

search.description: Text to search for in activity names and descriptions.

activityType.description: Parent activity type key to include, such as running or cycling. Must identify a parent type, not a subtype.

activitySubType.description: Activity subtype key to include. Must identify a child type and, if activityType is also provided, belong to that parent type. For example, use activitySubType=trail_running with activityType=running, or activitySubType=road_cycling with activityType=cycling.

eventType.description: Event classification key to include, such as race, training, recreation, fitness, specialEvent, or uncategorized.

minDistance.description: Inclusive minimum activity distance, in meters.

maxDistance.description: Inclusive maximum activity distance, in meters.

minDuration.description: Inclusive minimum activity timer duration, in seconds.

maxDuration.description: Inclusive maximum activity timer duration, in seconds.

minElevation.description: Inclusive minimum total elevation gain for the activity, in meters.

maxElevation.description: Inclusive maximum total elevation gain for the activity, in meters.

startDate.description: Inclusive earliest activity start date, based on the activity's local start time, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: Inclusive latest activity start date, based on the activity's local start time, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

upperLatitude.description: Northern latitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

rightLongitude.description: Eastern longitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

lowerLatitude.description: Southern latitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

leftLongitude.description: Western longitude boundary of the bounding box for activity start locations, in decimal degrees. Provide all four latitude and longitude boundaries to apply this filter.

lowerMaxDepth.description: Inclusive lower bound on the dive activity's maximum depth, in centimeters.

upperMaxDepth.description: Inclusive upper bound on the dive activity's maximum depth, in centimeters.

decoDive.description: Filter by decompression dive status: true returns decompression dives and false returns activities marked as non-decompression dives. Omit to apply no decompression dive filter.

minElapsedDuration.description: Inclusive minimum total elapsed activity duration, including paused time, in seconds.

maxElapsedDuration.description: Inclusive maximum total elapsed activity duration, including paused time, in seconds.

minBottomTime.description: Inclusive minimum dive bottom time, in seconds.

maxBottomTime.description: Inclusive maximum dive bottom time, in seconds.

minAvgPower.description: Inclusive minimum average activity power, in watts.

excludedActivitySubType.description: Activity subtype keys to exclude. Repeat this query parameter to exclude multiple subtypes.

requiredField.description: Activity fields that must have a non-null value for an activity to be included. Repeat this query parameter to require multiple fields; all specified fields must be present.

name: get_heart_rate_zones
title: Heart rate zones
description: Retrieve the user's heart rate zone configuration.

generateDefaults.description: Whether to generate default zones when the user has no configured zones.

name: download_activity
title: Download original activity file
description: Downloads the original activity file (usually a FIT file in a ZIP archive) as binary data. Disabled by default because assistants cannot interpret it.

activityId.description: The ID of the activity to download, as returned by search_activities.

name: get_fitness_age
title: Fitness age
description: Returns the lastest Fitness Age information as of the target calendar date.

calendarDate.description: The target date; Fitness Age information returned will be the latest available as of this date.

fullHistoryScan.description: Whether to scan the full history to find the latest Fitness Age information. If false, only the last 28 days relative to the target calendar date will be considered.

name: get_effective_weight_goals
title: Weight goals
description: Returns the authenticated user's effective weight goals and weight goal ranges for the requested date interval.

startDate.description: First calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

endDate.description: Last calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

name: get_daily_hrv
title: Daily heart rate variability
description: Returns heart rate variability (HRV) for one calendar date, including the overnight summary and the individual readings.

name: get_daily_hrv_summaries
title: HRV summaries for a date range
description: Returns daily heart rate variability (HRV) summaries for an inclusive date range.

fromDate.description: First calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

toDate.description: Last calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

name: get_daily_food_logs
title: Daily nutrition logs
description: Retrieves the user's daily nutrition summary for a specific calendar date. This includes the user's nutrition goals, nutrients consumed, and discrete events for the day. The response can optionally include meal-by-meal breakdowns of calories and other nutrients consumed by the user on the given date.

includeGoals.description: Goals are included by default unless requested with includeGoals=false

includeNutrition.description: Nutrition information is included by default unless requested with includeNutrition=false

includeMedia.description: Whether to include meal photos. Defaults to false here because image data is rarely useful to an assistant.

mealId.description: Id of the meal like id for Breakfast, Lunch, Snacks or Dinner

date.description: Date for which to retrieve the daily nutrition logs. Date must be in the YYYY-MM-DD format. The date is interpreted in the user's local timezone.

name: get_menstrual_cycle_summary
title: Menstrual cycle summary
description: Returns a summary of the user's menstrual cycle.

calendarDate.description: The calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd) to retrieve data for.

name: get_menstrual_cycle_day_view
title: Menstrual cycle day view
description: Returns detailed menstrual cycle information for a single calendar day, combining the user's logged daily data (symptoms, flow, mood, etc.), the cycle summary for that day, and (for pregnancy tracking) weekly weight goal ranges.

calendarDate.description: The calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd) to retrieve data for.

todayDate.description: Today's calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) from the user's perspective, used as the reference point for predictions.

reducedResponse.description: When true, returns a reduced/lightweight version of the response payload.

skipbm.description: When true, excludes baby movement (kick count) data from the response.

includeAnalysis.description: When true, includes menstrual cycle analysis data in the response.

name: get_daily_sleep
title: Daily sleep
description: Returns sleep data for the night ending on the given calendar date, including sleep stages, scores, and overnight metrics.

date.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the morning the sleep ended.

name: get_daily_sleep_summaries
title: Sleep summaries for a date range
description: Retrieves daily sleep summaries data for a date range, up to a maximum of 31 days. Maximum range: 31 days, inclusive.

startDate.description: First calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

endDate.description: Last calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

name: get_user_profile_settings
title: User profile settings
description: Returns the user's profile settings, including measurement system (metric or statute), time zone, locale, and date/time display formats.

name: get_daily_hydration
title: Daily hydration
description: Get daily hydration data for a date range, up to a maximum of 31 days. Maximum range: 31 days, inclusive.

startDate.description: First calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

endDate.description: Last calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

name: get_daily_steps
title: Daily steps
description: Get daily steps data for a date range, up to a maximum of 28 days. Maximum range: 28 days, inclusive.

startDate.description: First calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

endDate.description: Last calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

name: get_daily_stress
title: Daily stress
description: Get daily stress data for a date range, up to a maximum of 28 days. Maximum range: 28 days, inclusive.

startDate.description: First calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

endDate.description: Last calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

name: get_daily_user_summary
title: Daily summary
description: Get user summary data for a specific date. User summary data includes steps, calories, stress, Body Battery, and other wellness metrics for the given date.

name: get_daily_summaries
title: Daily summaries for a date range
description: Get user daily summaries for a date range, up to a maximum of 1 year. For a single day, use the same startDate and endDate. Maximum range: 366 days, inclusive.

startDate.description: First calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

endDate.description: Last calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

name: get_weight_entries
title: All weight entries
description: Retrieve all weight entries for a specified date range. Prefer get_weight_measurements when daily values or the range average are enough.

startDate.description: The start date(user's local calendar) of the range, inclusive. Format yyyy-MM-dd.

endDate.description: The end date(user's local calendar) of the range, inclusive. Format yyyy-MM-dd.

name: get_weight_measurements
title: Weight summaries
description: Retrieve weight summaries for a date range, including daily latest weights, the range average, and adjacent weights.

startDate.description: The start date(user's local calendar) of the range, inclusive. Format yyyy-MM-dd.

endDate.description: The end date(user's local calendar) of the range, inclusive. Format yyyy-MM-dd.

includeAll.description: If true, include all weight entries for each day in the range. If false, only include the latest weight entry for each day.

name: get_daily_body_battery
title: Daily Body Battery
description: Returns daily Body Battery reports for a date range, up to a maximum of 31 days. Maximum range: 31 days, inclusive.

startDate.description: First calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

endDate.description: Last calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

chunks.description: Number of time intervals each day is divided into; the response includes the lowest and highest Body Battery readings from each interval.

name: get_daily_spo2
title: Daily SpO2
description: Returns blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) readings and altitude acclimation data for a calendar date.

name: get_daily_heart_rate
title: Daily heart rate
description: Returns heart rate data for a calendar date, including resting heart rate and the intraday readings.

name: get_wellness_activity_summaries
title: Wellness activity summaries
description: Returns a list of wellness activity summaries for the given date range. The fromDate and untilDate are inclusive.

fromDate.description: First calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

untilDate.description: Last calendar date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.
